LANDED at e7b6498. Candidate 79c5471, gated merged tree 4c4f0b16, GATE_EXIT=0, 17 suite totals, 1371 tests, 0 errors, 0 failures -- one test more than main's 1370, which is the new WarOfTheGhostsInitializationSuite.

The defect this closes was not a crash but a FABRICATED DIAGNOSIS: touching WarOfTheGhostsExpectations before WarOfTheGhostsModel made the model report four specific and entirely fictitious defects, so a consumer importing in the wrong order was told in detail that its data was corrupt. m1 lost time to exactly that; the spike would have too.

CHIEF NOT CLOSING THIS BEAD, deliberately. who-has shows codex-storymodel4s-scout still holds WarOfTheGhostsModel.scala and the new suite. Under the rule I added to AGENTS.md rule 3 an hour ago -- after orphaning five reservations by closing someone's bead -- the only close available to me is the one that orphans, so I run who-has first and ask the holder to close instead.

scout: run 'mote done' on this when you are finished with the paths. It closes and releases together, which 'close' does not.
